_doc: Building data: the 12 styles (skins, trims, bay rhythms, dress, opening shares, piers, module), the style weights per building kind and era, the material palettes and the opening table (w = min(bay - w_in, w_max), sill, head = min(storey - head_in, head_max), reveal depth). Colours sRGB; finishes by name (cooked layer order of assets/surfaces/building-finishes).

openings._doc: One row per bay component: [w_in, w_max, sill, head_in, head_max, depth] (m): opening width = min(bay - w_in, w_max), sill above the storey floor, head = min(storey - head_in, head_max), reveal depth: the openings of the 4.0 (buildingMesh.ts openingOf), the look the game ports. Those are the bays a building does not size: where a block's facade names its window (facadeGeometry, a style's "opening": width and height as shares of the bay and the storey, the sill in metres) the window is that size and the caps here do not bind it. Sizes of a region belong to a style (styles.<id>), never to this table.

lots._doc: Lot layout rules (sim/buildings/b40/lot_*.cpp), metres. stall/aisle: a car bay and the lane in front of it at 90 deg (Sao Paulo COE, Decreto 57.776/2017 Anexo I, utility vehicle 2.50 x 5.50 m, access lane 5.50 m); stall_line: painted bay line width (CONTRAN, Manual Brasileiro de Sinalizacao de Transito vol. IV, 0.10 m). drive_lane: least clear width of a car's way (Sao Paulo Lei 16.642/2017, 2.75 m a direction); car_clear_h: least headroom over a car (same law, 2.30 m). person_gate: house / other lots, at least the 0.80 m clear opening of ABNT NBR 9050 (1.20 m on an accessible route). party_wall: side and back walls of a house / other lot (at least 1.80 m, Sao Paulo); front_low: the side walls beside the front garden. pool: width, depth and water depth of a residential pool, measured on the 4.0 small city (8 x 3.5 m, in 41 % of the house yards) with 1.4 m of water; terrace: the paved strip on the back door, measured there (3 m). garage_back_share: houses whose garage stands at the end of the drive in the yard (the rest at its front). yard_life_depth: a back yard at least this deep is lived in (a shed, a kitchen garden, a play corner or an orchard), measured on the 4.0 yards. max_elements: the most parts a lot lays (the 4.0 houses averaged 54, measured). garage_closed_share: houses whose car stands in a closed garage rather than under a carport (20 % of the 4.0 houses, measured). lorry_w: the widest lorry (2.60 m, Resolucao CONTRAN 210/2006); lorry_l: a single-unit lorry (AASHTO SU-30 design vehicle, 30 ft = 9.2 m); dock_margin: room each side of it in a loading dock. boundary: per lot kind, the front's choices [kind, height, base wall height] seen on the 4.0 photos (black bar fences on low walls, hedges, low front walls, railings, works fences), all under the 3.0 m front limit (Sao Paulo).

shapes._doc: The generator's shapes, one block per generator file (sim/buildings/b40/shapes.h), and the parts several files share. Metres unless the name says otherwise: _share a share, _pitch and pitch_ degrees, _lo and _hi the ends of a range drawn from, a whole number a count. The values are the source game's, as its files held them (B4 of log/review.md re-sources them).

civic._doc: Civic bodies (civic.cpp). The plaza in front takes front_share of the lot's depth, between front_min and front_max; the envelope keeps side_gap to each side and back_gap to the back; a civic storey is civic_storey. School: an L of a front wing wing_d deep (at most wing_d_share of the depth) and a side wing side_wing_w wide (at most side_wing_share of the width), school_storeys_lo to school_storeys_hi storeys under a school_roof_pitch hip roof, round a lawn holding a sports court (parts' court_w by court_d, lines court_line) kept court_edge in from the lawn's edge. Church: a nave nave_w wide (at most nave_w_share of the width) and nave_d long, nave_h high under a nave_pitch gable; a bell tower tower_w square of tower_storeys storeys of tower_storey under a tower_pitch spire; a gold cross cross_h high, cross_w across, cross_t thick, its arm at cross_arm_z of its height. Hospital: a ward block ward_share of the width and ward_d deep (at most ward_d_share of the depth) over a podium podium_d_share of the depth, hospital_lo to hospital_hi storeys (a clinic clinic_storeys); bands band_h high standing band_out proud; a red-cross sign sign_w square and sign_t thick, its bars sign_bar of it, sign_out off the wall; an entrance canopy canopy_w by canopy_d, canopy_t thick.

services._doc: Service bodies (civic_services.cpp). Gas station: a shop store_front_w wide, shop_d deep and shop_h high at the back; a canopy at canopy_z, canopy_t thick, at most canopy_w_max wide and canopy_d deep, canopy_edge in from the apron, on columns column square; pumps pump_w by pump_d, pump_h high, on islands island_w by island_d, island_h high, one each pump_every along; the apron's stripes stripe_t thick. Supermarket and mall: a box market_h (mall_h) high, a sign band sign_h high standing sign_out proud along sign_share of the front; parking in front in bays lots.stall_w wide and stall_d deep (stall_d drifted from lots.stall_d: B3 of log/review.md), lines stripe_w wide, an aisle aisle wide, the car park park_share of the depth and at most park_max; trolleys cart_w by cart_d, cart_h high. City hall: a ground storey hall_ground and hall_storeys storeys of hall_storey; a portico portico_d deep along portico_w_share of the front (at most portico_w_max) of columns columns, col square and col_h high, under an entablature entab_h high and a pediment of pediment_steps steps; steps step_h high reaching step_in out, a stair stair_h high and stair_d deep; a flag on a pole flag_pole thick and flag_h high, the flag flag_w by flag_d and flag_t thick. Police and fire stations: station_storeys storeys of station_storey, garage_bays garage doors; the fire station's hose tower tower_w square rising tower_storeys storeys over them (2 + 3 storeys of 4 m: 20 m); bands band_h high standing band_out proud.

facade._doc: The facade grammar's choices (facade_compose.cpp). A body of low_storeys storeys or fewer is low; a crown floor needs crown_min_levels levels. Canopies: over a ground floor at least canopy_wide_bays bays wide one reaching canopy_edge from the corners and canopy_pad past the door, canopy_drop under the first floor and at most canopy_max_z high, canopy_out proud, canopy_deep deep and canopy_thick thick; a recessed entrance recess deep (negative: into the wall) when the front is at least recess_min_w wide, along recess_share of it; a small canopy over a door at most small_canopy_max wide, small_drop under the first floor and at most small_max_z high, small_out proud, small_deep deep and small_thick thick. Relief: a body of relief_min_storeys storeys and relief_min_bays bays gets bays standing relief_out proud, skipping relief_skip of them (relief_wide_bays bays and more: wide relief); piers relief stand pier_out proud on bodies of pier_min_storeys storeys; a stone base is stone_base_k of the wall's lightness.

massing._doc: Roofs and skins (massing_core.cpp). A pitched roof is at least min_pitch; a roof flatter than flat_below of its rise reads flat; ridge_to_street of the bodies turn their ridge to the street; a sawtooth runs sawtooth_run a tooth. Rises: rise_gable, rise_shed, rise_sawtooth and rise_other, the most a roof of each kind rises; its pitch is drawn between the two ends of pitch_gable, pitch_hip, pitch_shed, pitch_saw or pitch_other (degrees). A second skin is tried second_skin_tries times for one at least second_skin_light lighter or darker, else the wall nudged by second_skin_nudge; a membrane roof's colour is nudged by membrane_nudge.

house._doc: Houses (massing_house.cpp). Floor-to-floor heights: storey_min_h the least, the ground storey up to ground_hi, the others storey_lo to storey_hi. The lowest leaves the 2.50 m clear a living room or bedroom needs (Sao Paulo COE, Decreto 57.776/2017 Anexo I 5.A.6) over a floor slab of at least 0.08 m (ABNT NBR 6118:2014 13.2.4.1) and its finish; the spread above it has no primary source yet (pending: storeys measured on photographed houses). A lot at least wide_lot wide takes a wide form; a bungalow is bungalow_w by bungalow_d under a pitch of bung_pitch_lo to bung_pitch_hi. Ell: a main block main_lo to main_hi deep and a wing ell_wing_share of the width (ell_wing_lo to ell_wing_hi), stepped back ell_step_share (ell_step_lo to ell_step_hi), the wing ell_wing_depth of the depth, of the same storeys in ell_same_storeys of the houses. Veranda (ver_): ver_lo to ver_hi deep in front of a main block ver_main_lo to ver_main_hi deep, a back room when ver_back_room is left (ver_back of the houses, at least ver_back_min wide, ver_back_lo to ver_back_hi of the width), inset ver_inset; a short veranda ver_short long along ver_short_share; its floor ver_floor_h high, its roof slab ver_slab_h thick, ver_slab_drop under the eaves, reaching ver_slab_pad past it, trimmed ver_slab_trim and ver_slab_back; posts post square (post_half its half), one each post_every. Twin: the split at twin_lo to twin_hi of the width, the back stepped twin_back_lo to twin_back_hi, main blocks twin_main_lo to twin_main_hi deep. Wing: a side wing wing_lo to wing_hi of the width, at least wing_min, when wing_min_room is left. double_door: the houses whose door is double.

tall._doc: Flats, shops and offices (massing_tall.cpp). Floor-to-floor heights: flats_ground_lo to flats_ground_hi and flats_storey_lo to flats_storey_hi; shops shop_ground_lo to shop_ground_hi and shop_storey; offices office_ground_lo to office_ground_hi and office_storey_lo to office_storey_hi. Every one leaves the 2.50 m clear of a room or a workplace (Sao Paulo COE, Decreto 57.776/2017 Anexo I 5.A.6) over a floor slab of at least 0.08 m (ABNT NBR 6118:2014 13.2.4.1). The city they make (map 0: flats 3.25 m and offices 3.73 m of wall per storey, the tall ground floor included) stays under the CTBUH database's height to the architectural top per floor (residential 3.42 m over 9,957 buildings, office 4.39 m over 7,344; skyscrapercenter.com height calculator), which adds crowns and plant floors these walls leave out. Shop storeys: the same minimum; their spread has no primary source yet. Storey counts: apartments from apartment_min, flats up to max_flats, towers min_tower to max_tower, tall towers min_tall to max_tall, shops up to shop_max (low streets shop_low_max), offices from workplace_min_f up to office_max_f. Shares of the bodies: tall_share tall, shop_ground with a shop on the ground, hip_share hipped, terrace_share with a roof terrace. Bars: bar_lo to bar_hi deep, stepping bar_step every bar_step_floors floors at least bar_step_d deep; a facade setback from facade_setback_lo, an inset up to inset_hi. Towers: at least tower_min wide, at most tower_max_d deep (offices office_max_d); a round tower has round_sides sides; its plan drawn rectangular under shape_rect and octagonal under shape_oct, its corners cut cut_lo to cut_hi; an ell tower from ell_tower_w wide (ell_lo to ell_hi, legs at least leg_min), twin towers from twin_tower_w wide with a gap of gap_lo to gap_hi, the twin's floors stepped by one of twin_steps (at least twin_min; offices office_twin_steps, at least office_twin_min), lift_extra storeys over the roof for the lift. Crowns: a cornice in from cornice_in_lo, a crown in up to crown_in_hi on towers of at least crown_min; setbacks from setback_lo to setback_hi of the tower, split past setback_split floors into setback_steps steps of at least setback_part, each one of setback_shares. Forms: a U from u_w wide (u_room left, wings u_wing_lo to u_wing_max), an L from l_w (l_share, wings l_wing_lo to l_wing_max, the low leg l_low of the floors in l_low_share), a pair from pair_w (pair_share of the bodies, split pair_lo to pair_hi, the back stepped pair_back_lo to pair_back_hi, pair_skin of them with a skin of their own). Cores: flats_core_d and office_core_d deep. Shops: shop_pitch of the one-storey colonial shops pitched, shop_terrace with a terrace; deep shops from shop_deep with a main block from shop_main_lo and a back room shop_back; pairs from shop_pair_w (shop_pair of them), stores at least store_min wide, shop_double with a double door, a side door from shop_side_door_w; awnings on awning_share of the shops, awning_y off the wall, at least awning_min wide, awning_d_lo to awning_d_hi deep, at awning_z, awning_h thick. Offices: a podium podium_share of the plan and at least podium_min, a crown office_crown_lo to office_crown_hi.

works._doc: Industrial halls (massing_works.cpp). The hall is hall_lo to hall_hi high: it clears the 3.50 m a lorry needs (Sao Paulo COE, Decreto 57.776/2017 Anexo I 8.D.II), its 7-9 m has no primary source yet. The office annex storey is office_storey, leaving the 2.50 m clear of a workplace (5.A.6) over its slab; the annex stands in front on lots at least annex_d deep and annex_w wide with annex_room left, annex_w_lo to annex_w_hi wide and annex_d_lo to annex_d_hi deep. A loading door every loading_every bays of the back.

paint._doc: The nudge of a roof's or a second skin's colour (paint.cpp), in HSL: up to half of hue_step of a turn of hue, half of sat_step of saturation and half of light_step of lightness each way, times the nudge's amount; lightness kept between light_min and light_max. A skin's lightness is scaled by tint_lo plus a share of tint_span (facade_compose.cpp).

survey._doc: A building read off a 3D model (sim/commands/body_survey.cpp), metres. Tops meet within touch_m; a face whose normal is at least flat_normal up is flat; a top at least least_top_z high and least_top_side a side counts; a block is at least least_block across and least_block_h high. Storeys: the first first_storey_m, the others storey_m, a level within on_first_storey_m of the first is on it. Faces stand face_out_m out; a wall lighter than light_wall reads light, a base differing by base_differs reads apart, a low share ends at low_share_end. Piers pier_w_m by pier_d_m; a crown from crown_least_m and crown_share of the top; the roof sampled above_roof_m over it; bays: wall_share of a wall, door_share a door, wide_share wide; hulls kept hull_gap_m apart. Samples: from sample_from of a face, walls from wall_up_from in steps of wall_up_step, bays from bay_up_from over bay_up_span; wall_along by wall_up samples of a wall, bay_along by bay_up of a bay, at least least_samples and least_light lit; tall_storeys and top_storeys read the top, least_based_top the least a based top holds; the top grid's cell at least least_cell_m. A pixel nearer than its point by more than hidden_m hides it (survey_picture.cpp).

parts._doc: The parts several generator files lay alike, one owner each. cover_h: a ground cover's thickness (lawn, paving, a court; each later layer lifts space.cover_step more). The sports court of a school and of an open lot: court_w by court_d, its lines court_line wide. A bench's seat bench_h high. A drain grate drain square and drain_h thick. A pallet pallet square and pallet_h high. A lamp post lamp square (back yards, side paths and front gardens). A yard swing swing_w by swing_d and swing_h high (a park's is open.swing_*). way_side: a car's way is its drive less this each side (a door opened, a wing mirror).

back._doc: The back zone of lots other than houses (lot_back.cpp). A car park: rows of bays (lots.stall_w x stall_d) along the back boundary and, for two rows, along the building, bay_off_wall off a wall, the second row starting row_from in and left open door_gap at the back door; the ends too short for a bay (at least planter_min) planted in a planter planter_d deep and planter_h high, a tree crowned at crown_top; the walk from the back door walk_w wide. Lamps on the back wall each wall_lamp_every at wall_lamp_z, wall_lamp_out proud, wall_lamp_w by wall_lamp_h. A service yard: bins bin_w by bin_d, bin_h high, at bin_x and bin_y, and a skip skip_w by skip_d, skip_h high, at skip_x and skip_y; pallets at pallet_x and pallet_y; a caged gas store cage_w by cage_d, cage_h high, cage_in from the side, on yards at least cage_min_w wide; air conditioners ac_w by ac_d, ac_h high, at ac_z, one each ac_every; a lamp service_lamp_h high at service_lamp_x and service_lamp_y. A residents' court: a paved square square_w by square_d, square_from from the building, benches bench_w by bench_d at bench_x; a sand play corner play square, play_in in, on courts at least play_min_w wide and play_min_d deep; trees court_tree wide in the corners, court_tree_in and court_tree_back in; a bin court_bin_in in. A loading yard: a dock at each loading door, dock_edge from the yard's edge, centred within dock_on_door of the door, docks dock_apart apart; bollards bollard square and bollard_h high standing bollard_out in front of its mouth; the yard's lamps yard_lamp_h high, yard_lamp_in in, yard_back from the back.

boundary._doc: The lot's boundary (lot_boundary.cpp). A wall is boundary_wall_t thick, a fence or railing fence_thick, a hedge hedge_thick. A car gate is its drive less gate_post each side; a run stops gate_gap short of a gate; a building within attach of an edge closes it; stretches shorter than shortest_run are left to the posts and corners; a side path's gate is the path less walk_trim.

cars._doc: Where a house's car stands and how the side strips are used (lot_cars.cpp). A garage's walls are garage_wall thick (its back wall behind the bay; the lot access search, sim/buildings/lot_access.cpp, keeps cars out of them, the door side open), the garage standing garage_set behind the front garden (or behind the house in the yard); a carport's posts carport_post square and its slab carport_slab thick over the car's headroom; a car pad clears the side wall and the bay's edges by pad_margin. Drives: a drain drain_before from the end of the drive, at drive_drain_at on a long one. Side paths used as alleys (at least alley_lamp_min long): a lamp alley_lamp_h high, drains alley_drain wide each drain_every, bins bin_w by bin_d and bin_h high, crates crate square and crate_h high, crate_gap apart, back_end from the back. Side gardens: a tree side_tree wide and side_tree_h high each side_tree_every, shrubs side_shrub_h high.

front._doc: The front zone (lot_front.cpp). A garden: the walk to the door path_w wide, the walks along the front link_d deep; beds along the boundary bed_in in, each bed_every, bed square and bed_h high, shrub_share of them shrubs; beds under the windows window_bed_w by window_bed_d, window_bed_h high, each window_bed_every, window_bed_out from the wall; a tree before the house front_crown wide crowned at front_crown_top on fronts at least tree_min_f deep, tree_in in, each tree_every from tree_from. A forecourt: pairs of benches (bench_w by bench_d) or planters (planter square, planter_h high) each pair_every, pair_share of them benches, on fronts at least pair_min_f deep, at pair_at of the depth, pair_gap apart; bollards bollard square and bollard_h high at bollard_at, each bollard_every (on plazas plaza_bollard_every); a bin bin_w by bin_d and bin_h high, bin_in in, bin_out from the boundary. A plaza: trees in planters plaza_planter square each plaza_every from plaza_from, plaza_tree wide and plaza_tree_h high, at plaza_at of the depth, with a bench plaza_bench by plaza_bench_d; lamps lamp_h high, lamp_in in, lamp_back from the building. A works' apron: the walk apron_path wide, lamps apron_lamp_h high at apron_lamp_x, apron_lamp_in in; the visitors' bays visitor_from from the side and visitor_door from the door.

ground._doc: The ground of every zone and the ways kept clear (lot_ground.cpp). The people's way is their gate and door_way_pad each side, reaching at least door_way_min in from the street; a loading yard's turning ground stops edge_keep short of the boundary. (A car's way: parts.way_side.)

plan._doc: The plan of a grown lot (lot_plan.cpp): its front, sides and back uses and the building's envelope, by the lot's kind and size. Ways: a drive drive wide (a house's house_drive), a footpath footpath, an alley alley, a wide path wide_path, a lorry's lane truck_lane. Houses: narrow below narrow_w (narrow_lot: no side path; house_paths_w: a path each side, house_path wide), deep from deep_house and mid from mid_house; a car pad carpad deep; a front garden garden_lo to garden_hi (small_garden on small lots), a side garden on lots from side_garden_w (side_garden_lo to side_garden_hi), a side path from side_path_w; the house house_min to house_max deep, the yard yard_lo to yard_hi and at least yard_min. Flats: from apartment_w wide and flats_d deep, a garden flats_garden of the front (flats_garden_lo to flats_garden_hi), parking from parking_w, blocks at least min_block, attached_share of them attached, a court when court_spare is left (at most court_max); towers on a plaza tower_plaza deep from tower_plaza_d. Shops: a court from shop_court_d (shop_court of it, shop_court_lo to shop_court_hi), parking from shop_park_w (shop_park of the depth), a service yard from shop_service (service_lo to service_hi, at most service_max). Offices: a plaza from office_plaza_d (plaza_lo to plaza_hi), a court office_court, parking from office_park_w, workplaces at least workplace_min, a service yard from office_service (office_service_d deep). Works: an apron apron deep from apron_d (deeper ones from apron_deep), works from works_w wide and works_d deep, a path from works_path_w; a loading yard loading_share of the depth between loading_min and loading_max, loading_full deep with loading_extra more for a full turn.

space._doc: The lot in its own frame and the rule every part obeys (lot_space.cpp): a part keeps lot_clear_in inside the lot's edge (the boundary stands on it), two solid parts are at least part_gap apart, and each later ground cover lifts cover_step over the one before (their thickness: parts.cover_h).

yard._doc: A house's back yard and the courts a building leaves free in its envelope (lot_yard.cpp). A pool (lots.pool) pool_gap from the house and pool_side from the sides with pool_room around, its stone deck deck wide, two loungers lounger_w by lounger_l, lounger_h high, lounger_gap apart and lounger_out from the pool. Beds along the back wall each bed_every, bed_w by bed_d, bed_h high, bed_back from the wall from bed_from; trees in the back corners corner_tree wide and tree_h high, corner_tree_in and corner_tree_back in; bushes bush wide topping at bush_top along the side walls, shrub_in in, each shrub_every to shrub_to from the back. A clothes line on clothes_share of the yards at least line_min_d deep, line_h high, line_span of the width, line_from in, line_d from the house. The terrace: a bench bench_w by bench_d at bench_x, pots pot square and pot_h high each pot_every, pot_in in; a corner corner wide; bins bin_w by bin_d and bin_h high. The lived part of a deep yard from life_from of it, life_in in, one of five themes: an orchard (a fruit tree fruit wide and fruit_h high each orchard_every), a kitchen garden (boxes plot_w by box_d, box_h high, box_cols by box_rows from box_x and box_y, box_in in) with a coop coop_w by coop_d, coop_h high, coop_in in; a play corner (sand sand square); a workshop shed shed_w by shed_d, shed_h high; an edicula edicula_w by edicula_d, edicula_h high, with its deck deck_d deep, a table table square and table_h high with seats seat_w by seat_d at seat_at, a dog house dog square and dog_h high. Free courts: at least free_min wide; a small one (below small_w by small_d) tiled with a planter planter square and planter_h high; a large one a garden square at most square_max, square_in in, trees free_tree_in in, flowers free_flowers wide and flowers_h high.

open._doc: Open lots (open_lots.cpp). Park: a lawn lawn_clear in from the lot behind a hedge hedge_h high and hedge_t thick; a cross of paths path_w wide with a ring walk ring_w wide ring_share of the lot in, on lots at least ring_min; trees tree_clear off every way; a fountain on lots from fountain_min: a basin basin square in a rim rim_h high and rim_t thick, on a paved round-point pool_plaza square, a spout spout square and spout_h high under a bowl bowl wide and bowl_h thick; a sand playground play square on lots from play_min: swings swing_w wide and swing_h high on posts post square with chains chain thick and seats seat wide at seat_z, a climbing frame frame square and frame_h high, a see-saw seesaw_l by seesaw_w at seesaw_z; benches bench_w by bench_d each bench_every along the paths, lamps lamp square and lamp_h high each lamp_every, bins bin square and bin_h high. Square: paving with lawn borders lot_edge wide; a bandstand on squares from band_min, band square on columns band_col, band_h high under a roof band_roof thick on a deck band_deck high. Sports court (parts.court_*): court_run of run-off around, a fence fence_h high, goals goal_w by goal_d and goal_h high, a centre circle circle wide; painted lines lift lift_line and the inner ones lift_inner covers over the court.

interior._doc: A body's interior (interior/interior.cpp). Flights between blocks at floors of their own: at least flight_least_m of a block left over them, standing flight_over_m over the floor, flight_line_m from the wall, risers of flight_rise_m and treads of flight_tread_m (at least flight_tread_min_m: ABNT NBR 9050 6.8 asks risers of 0.16 to 0.18 m and treads of 0.28 to 0.32 m), flight_width_m wide with flight_side_m to the side and flight_clear_m of clear, flight_room_m of room at their foot. A room reaches room_reach from a window; homes along a floor are unit_modules of the style's module wide. Rooms off a corridor take office_room_bays, class_room_bays, hotel_room_bays and ward_room_bays bays. A homely floor is wood in wood_share of light_share floors (porcelain in the rest). A hospital's wards start ward_from_ground over the ground. A piece under the pointer is found within reach_past_m past its size (reach_unsized_m round one of no size: sim/commands/body_furnish.cpp).

homes._doc: The floors people live on (interior/interior_homes.cpp); sizes of rooms are common Brazilian dwelling practice, the pieces' sizes interiors.json's. Names: _u along a room from its door's side, _s, _y and _back in from its wall, _x across; the others the room's size, a gap, a margin or a share. A flat (from its plan): the door door_margin from the corner (door_share of the bays), the bedroom's door bed_door_in in, the bathroom bath_d deep with a door bath_door wide; the living room's tv, sofa, table and chairs, the kitchen's fridge, stove and sink, a plant, the bed, wardrobe, toilet and bath at their _u and _s. A house (from small_house wide): the ground and the upstairs split mid_margin from the middle, stairs stair_run long at stair_x and stair_y; kitchen, living room (sofa_x, armchair, books), dining (table, seats), bathroom (bath_deep, toilet), bedrooms (room_door, bed_end, wardrobe), a hall hall_d deep with doors door_apart apart, a desk and shelves at their offsets. Homes along a floor: units at least unit_min wide, their doors unit_door from the corridor, split at unit_split; a hotel room's bed, wardrobe and desk; a flat's living (sofa_share, sofa_back, tv_off, table_share, seat_off), kitchen (u_fridge, u_stove, u_sink, u_kitchen), bedroom (bed_share; wide units from wide_unit) and bathroom (bath_wall, bath_wall_door, u_bath, u_toilet), a plant u_plant. A lobby: a desk desk_front from the front, sofas and a plant.

rooms._doc: Floors that are not homes (interior/interior_rooms.cpp); clearances are the ones a person needs to pass and sit, the pieces' sizes interiors.json's. Names: _u along a room, _s, _back and _from in from its wall, _gx and _gy a grid's steps, _in an inset, _to a reach. A room's door at least room_door_min from the corner and room_door_back from the back. Offices: a meeting table meet_depth deep with seats meet_seat and rows meet_row; shelves and plants off the wall; desks after desks_after; a WC wc_depth deep with its door wc_door, toilets toilet_gap apart from toilet_from, basins; desk rows desk_row and desk_col apart with an aisle aisle; an open office's grid open_gx by open_gy from open_in, chairs and plants each open_plant_gap. Classrooms: the board, the teacher and pupils' desks (pupil_gap apart, pupil_chair), rooms class_room long and at least class_min, rows of desks row_gx by row_gy from row_from. Wards: beds bed_gap apart, two rows on rooms from two_rows deep, a visitor's chair, a plant; a ward's grid ward_gx by ward_gy. Hotel rooms: the bed, tv, desk, wardrobe, bathroom (hotel_bath_s deep, hotel_bath_door), toilet and tub at their _u and _s. Shops: a stockroom when back_need is left, its door back_door, shop_back deep (eat_back for a place to eat, bar_back for a bar); counters, shelves and racks at their offsets and gaps, a stock desk and toilet. Places to eat: the counter, the bar's seats, the kitchen's cooking line (cook_from to cook_end, cook_gap apart, cook_s from the wall) and table, the dining grid dine_row by dine_col. Cells room_cell wide with a bed and a table; malls of units mall_unit wide with doors mall_door, counters and shelves, sofas and plants in the mall's middle on grids.

floor_plan._doc: A floor's plan (interior/plan.cpp): its pieces keep inset from the walls and pad between them, a ground floor's front room is front_room deep, the core stands core_x and core_y in, a corridor is corridor wide and a floor at least double_loaded deep has rooms on both its sides; a piece set along a wall stands off_wall off it.

roof._doc: A volume's roof when it names no pitch (roof_shape.h): a gable gable_deg and a shed shed_deg degrees; a sawtooth's teeth about saw_step_m deep (the source game's).
